text: 你伏低身子，更多矮小的灰色人影走进林间空地；另有一道高瘦细长的身影也随之出现，披着鹿皮。灰色人影围成一圈，绕着火光缓慢蹒跚起舞。行过献祭的那人捡起落下的头颅，恭敬地献给蒙面的身影。对方任由披肩滑落，显露出一名白人老妇人，她面容可怖，气势逼人。
老妇人从萨满手中接过头颅，吟诵着颤抖不稳的咒歌。她将血淋淋的祭品高举过头，让鲜血洒在银白的发髻上，举行这场骇人的血祭。
你听到头顶传来有节奏的窸窣声，空气中还混着嗡鸣。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 248
text: While you hug the earth, more undersized gray men enter the glen—and so does another figure, a tall, spindly shape cloaked in deerskin. The gray ones form a circle and commence a slow, shuffling dance around the light. The one who performed the sacrifice picks up the fallen head and offers it, with reverence, to the cowled figure. The latter lets her wrap fall away. She stands revealed as an old Caucasian woman of frightful, imposing aspect.
The woman accepts the head from the shaman and intones a wavering chant. She lifts the bleeding trophy above her head and accepts its blood, a hideous libation upon her hoary locks.
You hear a rhythmic crinkling sound mixed with buzzing in the air overhead.
